nodes.description: uint8 private _chainID, id of the chain this bridge lives on, set in initialize.
uint256 private _expiry, block offset added to block.number when a proposal is created.
bool private _whitelistEnabled, toggles the whitelist gate on deposits.
uint256 public totalRelayers counter, incremented/decremented on relayer role grant/revoke.
uint64 public _quorum, number of votes required for a proposal to pass.
IVoterUpgradeable public _voter, external voting contract used for mint/burn/vote/execute.
mapping(uint8 => uint64) private _depositCounts, per destination chain deposit nonce.
mapping(bytes32 => address) private, maps resourceID to handler contract address.
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _proposals, proposalHash to voter issue id.
mapping(address => bool) private _whitelist of allowed depositors.
mapping(uint256 => proposalStruct) private _proposalDetails holding proposal metadata.
bytes32 public constant FEE_SETTER_ROLE used to gate fee configuration.
bytes32 public constant RELAYER_ROLE used to gate voting and execution.
bytes32 public constant PAUSER_ROLE used to gate pause/unpause.
bytes32 public constant RESOURCE_SETTER used to gate handler resource configuration.
bytes32 public constant EMERGENCY_ROLE used to gate manual withdrawals.
public view returning _chainID.
public view returning _expiry.
public view returning _whitelistEnabled.
public view returning _depositCounts for a chain id.
public view returning handler address for a resource id.
public view returning voter issue id for a proposal hash.
public view returning whitelist status of a beneficiary.
pure helper computing keccak256 of chainID, depositNonce and dataHash.
view helper querying _voter.Voted with msg.sender.
external initializer setting admin role, voter, chain id, quorum and expiry.
UUPS upgrade authorisation restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
Overridden AccessControl grantRole, mints a voter token and bumps totalRelayers for RELAYER_ROLE.
Overridden AccessControl revokeRole, burns a voter token and decrements totalRelayers.
admin function adding an address to _whitelist.
admin function removing an address from _whitelist.
admin function enabling or disabling the whitelist gate.
PAUSER_ROLE gated pause.
PAUSER_ROLE gated unpause.
admin function updating _quorum.
admin function updating _expiry.
RESOURCE_SETTER function mapping resourceID to handler and calling handler.setResource.
RESOURCE_SETTER function calling handler.setTokenDecimals.
admin function calling handler.setOneSplitAddress.
admin function calling handler.setLiquidityPool.
admin function calling handler.setLiquidityPoolOwner.
RESOURCE_SETTER function mapping resourceID and calling generic handler setResource.
admin function calling handler.setBurnable.
EMERGENCY_ROLE nonReentrant function calling handler.withdraw to release funds.
EMERGENCY_ROLE nonReentrant function calling handler.withdrawFees.
admin function toggling handler fee status through the resource mapping.
FEE_SETTER_ROLE function configuring bridge fees on a handler.
view function returning bridge fees from a handler.
public nonReentrant, whitelist gated entry point forwarding to _deposit.
payable nonReentrant entry point wrapping msg.value into WETH then calling _deposit.
private core deposit logic: builds SwapInfo, bumps nonce and calls handler.deposit.
internal pure decoder of calldata using abi.decode and inline assembly.
public staking entry point calling the liquidity pool with msg.sender.
payable nonReentrant staking of ETH via WETH wrap and liquidity pool.
public unstaking entry point calling the liquidity pool.
nonReentrant unstaking of ETH via WETH and liquidity pool.
RELAYER_ROLE function creating or voting proposals using block.number + _expiry.
admin function deleting a cancelled proposal entry.
RELAYER_ROLE function executing a passed proposal via the handler and voter.
view function returning voter issue struct for a proposal.
Caller controlled address used in access checks, depositor fields and voter calls.
Block level environment value; block.number is used together with _expiry for proposal deadlines.
External call depositHandler.deposit(resourceID, destinationChainID, nonce, swapDetails) with a state-mutated nonce already written.
External call depositHandler.executeProposal(swapDetails, resourceID) releasing value to an attacker influenced recipient.
External call handler.withdraw(tokenAddress, recipient, amount) moving tokens out of the handler safe.
External call handler.withdrawFees(tokenAddress, recipient, amount).
External call _voter.mint(account) executed inside grantRole before event emission, unchecked return.
External call _voter.burn(account) executed inside revokeRole, unchecked return.
depositETH wraps msg.value via IWETH(weth).deposit{value} and transfers WETH to msg.sender.
stakeETH wraps msg.value into WETH, transfers it to the handler and calls stakeETH.
Inline assembly mload decoding of user supplied calldata slices in unpackDepositData.
Pre-increment ++_depositCounts[destinationChainID] used as replay protection nonce.
totalRelayers + 1 and totalRelayers - 1 arithmetic on role grant and revoke.
External voter calls _voter.vote, _voter.executeProposal, _voter.setStatus and _voter.createProposal.
External call depositHandler.stake(msg.sender, tokenAddress, amount) without nonReentrant guard.
External call depositHandler.unstake(msg.sender, tokenAddress, amount) without nonReentrant guard.
External call depositHandler.unstakeETH(msg.sender, WETH, amount).
chainID parameter of initialize.
quorum parameter of initialize.
expiry parameter of initialize.
voter address parameter of initialize.
role bytes32 parameter of grantRole.
account address parameter of grantRole.
beneficiary address parameter of addToWhitelist and removeFromWhitelist.
newQuorum parameter of adminChangeQuorum.
newExpiry parameter of adminChangeExpiry.
handlerAddress parameter of admin configuration functions.
resourceID bytes32 parameter used for handler lookups.
tokenAddress parameter of admin token functions.
Calldata bytes parameter unpacked into SwapInfo.
recipient address parameter of adminWithdraw.
amount parameter of stake, unstake, withdraw and unstakeETH.
destinationChainID parameter of deposit and depositETH.
feeTokenAddress parameter of deposit and setBridgeFee.
distribution uint256 array parameter of deposit and executeProposal.
flags uint256 array parameter of deposit and executeProposal.
path address array parameter of deposit and executeProposal.
chainID parameter of voteProposal.
depositNonce parameter of voteProposal.
dataHash parameter of voteProposal.
proposalHash local computed from chainID, depositNonce and dataHash.
IDepositExecute.SwapInfo memory struct built from calldata and caller data.
currentStatus local holding the voter ProposalStatus of a proposal.

fetch_expiry returns the _expiry state variable.

HasVotedOnProposal forwards the caller address into _voter.Voted.
initialize consumes the chainID parameter when seeding _chainID.
initialize consumes the quorum parameter when setting _quorum.
initialize consumes the expiry parameter when setting _expiry.
initialize assigns the voter parameter to the _voter contract reference.
initialize writes _chainID from the chainID parameter.
initialize writes _quorum from the quorum parameter.
initialize writes _expiry from the expiry parameter.

_authorizeUpgrade is restricted by onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) against msg.sender.
grantRole branches on the caller supplied role parameter compared to RELAYER_ROLE.
grantRole passes the account parameter to the voter mint call.
grantRole is gated by onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) evaluated on msg.sender.
grantRole only mints and bumps relayers when role equals RELAYER_ROLE.
grantRole reads the _voter contract to mint and to check balanceOf.
grantRole performs the external _voter.mint(account) side effect for new relayers.
grantRole increments totalRelayers, altering the trusted relayer count.
revokeRole only burns tokens when role equals RELAYER_ROLE.
revokeRole reads _voter for balance checks and burn.
revokeRole performs the external _voter.burn(account) side effect.
revokeRole decrements totalRelayers, altering the trusted relayer count.
revokeRole is gated by onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) evaluated on msg.sender.
addToWhitelist stores the beneficiary parameter into the whitelist mapping.
addToWhitelist writes the _whitelist mapping.
addToWhitelist is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
removeFromWhitelist clears the beneficiary entry in the whitelist mapping.
removeFromWhitelist writes the _whitelist mapping.
removeFromWhitelist is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
setWhitelisting writes the _whitelistEnabled gate.
setWhitelisting is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
pause is restricted to PAUSER_ROLE holders.
unpause is restricted to PAUSER_ROLE holders.
adminChangeQuorum stores the newQuorum parameter, truncated to uint64.
adminChangeQuorum writes the _quorum state variable.
adminChangeQuorum is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
adminChangeExpiry stores the newExpiry parameter.
adminChangeExpiry writes the _expiry state variable.
adminChangeExpiry is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
adminSetResource uses the handlerAddress parameter as the handler contract.
adminSetResource maps the resourceID parameter to the handler.
adminSetResource forwards the tokenAddress parameter to handler.setResource.
adminSetResource writes _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
adminSetResource is restricted to RESOURCE_SETTER holders.
adminSetTokenDecimals casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandlerDecimals.
adminSetTokenDecimals is restricted to RESOURCE_SETTER holders.
adminSetOneSplitAddress casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandler.
adminSetOneSplitAddress is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
adminSetLiquidityPool casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandler.
adminSetLiquidityPool is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
adminSetLiquidityPoolOwner casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandler.
adminSetLiquidityPoolOwner is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
adminSetGenericResource casts the handlerAddress parameter to IGenericHandler.
adminSetGenericResource maps the resourceID parameter to the handler.
adminSetGenericResource writes _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
adminSetGenericResource is restricted to RESOURCE_SETTER holders.
adminSetBurnable casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandler.
adminSetBurnable is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
adminWithdraw casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandler.
adminWithdraw passes the tokenAddress parameter to handler.withdraw.
adminWithdraw passes the recipient parameter to handler.withdraw.
adminWithdraw passes the amount parameter to handler.withdraw.
adminWithdraw triggers an external handler.withdraw call that moves funds out.
adminWithdraw is restricted to EMERGENCY_ROLE holders.
adminWithdrawFees casts the handlerAddress parameter to IERCHandler.
adminWithdrawFees triggers an external handler.withdrawFees call.
adminWithdrawFees is restricted to EMERGENCY_ROLE holders.
adminSetFeeStatus resolves the handler from _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
adminSetFeeStatus is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
setBridgeFee resolves the handler address from the resourceID parameter.
setBridgeFee reads _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
setBridgeFee is restricted to FEE_SETTER_ROLE holders.
setBridgeFee is gated by the FEE_SETTER_ROLE constant.
setBridgeFee forwards the destination chain id used for fee configuration.
setBridgeFee forwards the feeTokenAddress parameter to the handler.
getBridgeFee resolves the handler from the resourceID parameter.
getBridgeFee reads _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
deposit is gated by the isWhitelisted modifier checking msg.sender against _whitelist.
deposit delegates its logic to the private _deposit function.
deposit forwards the untrusted data parameter.
deposit forwards destinationChainID used to index _depositCounts.
deposit forwards the distribution array into the deposit flow.
deposit forwards the flags array into the deposit flow.
deposit forwards the swap path array into the deposit flow.
deposit forwards the feeTokenAddress parameter.
depositETH wraps msg.value via IWETH.deposit and transfers WETH back to msg.sender.
depositETH is gated by the isWhitelisted modifier on msg.sender.
depositETH calls _deposit after wrapping native funds.
depositETH forwards the untrusted data parameter.
_deposit calls an arbitrary handler resolved from resourceID, handing over swapDetails and the fresh nonce.
_deposit performs ++_depositCounts[destinationChainID] before the external handler call.
The nonce arithmetic mutates the _depositCounts mapping.
_deposit assigns msg.sender to swapDetails.depositer, an unauthenticated identity value.
_deposit resolves swapDetails.handler from _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
_deposit builds and forwards the swapDetails struct to the handler.
unpackDepositData slices and decodes the untrusted calldata parameter.
unpackDepositData uses inline assembly mload on attacker controlled byte slices.
stake casts the caller supplied handler address to ILiquidityPool.
stake passes msg.sender as the depositor to the liquidity pool.
stake forwards the amount parameter to the pool.
stake performs an external depositHandler.stake call without a reentrancy guard.
unstake casts the caller supplied handler address to ILiquidityPool.
unstake passes msg.sender as the unstaker.
unstake forwards the amount parameter to the pool.
unstake performs an external depositHandler.unstake call without a reentrancy guard.
stakeETH casts the caller supplied handler address to ILiquidityPool and IERCHandler.
stakeETH passes msg.sender as the depositor.
stakeETH wraps msg.value into WETH, transfers it to the handler and calls stakeETH.
unstakeETH casts the caller supplied handler address.
unstakeETH passes msg.sender as the unstaker.
unstakeETH forwards the amount parameter.
unstakeETH performs an external depositHandler.unstakeETH call.
voteProposal builds the proposal hash from the caller supplied chainID.
voteProposal builds the proposal hash from the caller supplied depositNonce.
voteProposal builds the proposal hash from the caller supplied dataHash.
voteProposal derives proposalHash and uses it to index _proposals.
voteProposal reads and writes the _proposals mapping.
voteProposal uses _expiry when computing the proposal end block.
voteProposal forwards _quorum to _voter.createProposal.
voteProposal depends on block.number plus _expiry for proposal expiry timing.
voteProposal performs external voter calls createProposal, vote, setStatus and getStatus.
voteProposal records a vote for msg.sender through _voter.vote.
voteProposal is gated by onlyRole(RELAYER_ROLE).
cancelProposal is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.
cancelProposal deletes the _proposals entry for the derived hash.
cancelProposal reads currentStatus from the voter before deleting.
executeProposal performs an external handler executeProposal call that releases bridged value.
executeProposal externally marks the voter issue as executed.
executeProposal reads the proposal id from _proposals.
executeProposal resolves the handler from _resourceIDToHandlerAddress.
executeProposal uses the caller supplied resourceID for handler resolution.
executeProposal hashes and decodes the untrusted data parameter.
executeProposal forwards swapDetails to the handler.
executeProposal requires currentStatus to equal the Passed proposal status.
executeProposal is gated by onlyRole(RELAYER_ROLE).
executeProposal access depends on the relayer role held by msg.sender.
getProposal resolves the issue id through _proposals.
getProposal queries _voter.fetchIssueMap.
pause stops proposal creation, voting and execution.
removeFromWhitelist clears the _whitelist mapping entry.

normalization_plan.reason: chainID is a parameter consumed only by initialize to seed _chainID.
quorum is a parameter consumed only by initialize to seed _quorum.
expiry is a parameter consumed only by initialize to seed _expiry.
voter is a parameter assigned to the trusted _voter state variable.
role is the parameter that decides the voter mint branch in grantRole.
account is the parameter forwarded to _voter.mint inside grantRole.
beneficiary is the parameter written into the _whitelist mapping.
newQuorum is the parameter stored in _quorum.
newExpiry is the parameter stored in _expiry.
handlerAddress is cast to IERCHandler before the external withdrawal call.
resourceID is the key used to map a handler address in storage.
tokenAddress is forwarded to handler.withdraw which moves funds.
data is the untrusted calldata decoded and forwarded into the handler deposit call.
recipient is the destination of the privileged adminWithdraw transfer.
amount controls the quantity of tokens withdrawn by adminWithdraw.
destinationChainID indexes the _depositCounts nonce arithmetic.
feeTokenAddress is used for handler fee configuration.
distribution shapes the swap executed by the deposit handler.
flags modify handler behaviour during deposit execution.
path defines the swap route used by the deposit handler.
chainID participates in the proposal hash used for voting.
depositNonce participates in the proposal hash used for voting.
dataHash participates in the proposal hash used for voting.
proposalHash is a pure local derived from the voting parameters.
swapDetails is a local struct assembled for the external handler deposit call.
currentStatus is a local holding the voter status checked before execution.
